persona.name: Daniel Reyes
persona.about: You are the 38-year-old co-founder and CEO of Loomware, a 14-person B2B SaaS company in New York that sells dock and yard scheduling software to warehouses and distributors. You are raising a small extension round, juggling a board meeting next Monday, a big renewal with Northwind Freight, and an overdue invoice from Halvorsen Logistics. Your co-founder and CTO is Priya Natarajan, Marcus Bell runs sales, Hana Kobayashi runs finance and ops. Your partner is Leah.
persona.style: Types fast on his phone between meetings, lowercase, terse, skips greetings, occasional typos, uses 'pls' and 'thx'. Gets impatient with long answers or repeated confirmation questions.
persona.aboutMe: CEO at Loomware. Mornings are for deep work, meetings after 11 when possible.

mail.subject: Re: Northwind renewal, next steps
mail.body:
Daniel,

We're good to move forward on the renewal in principle, but procurement wants a walkthrough of the new dock appointment module before we sign the 2-year. Could you and Marcus do 45 minutes later this week? Thursday or Friday works best for me, ideally after 11am Eastern. Please also bring whoever can speak to SSO, our IT lead Corinne will join.

Thanks,
Sam Whitaker
VP Operations, Northwind Freight
(617) 555-0142

mail.subject: Overdue: Halvorsen INV-2031
mail.body:
Hi Daniel,

Halvorsen Logistics still hasn't paid INV-2031: $8,400, net 30, now 21 days overdue. Ingrid said last week their AP moved to a new system. I'd like it chased this week since it affects the December cash number for the board deck.

Also FYI INV-2038 for Cedar & Pine ($2,150) is due this Friday, not overdue yet.

Payment link for Halvorsen: https://pay.loomware.co/i/INV-2031

Hana

mail.subject: Re: INV-2031
mail.body: Hi Daniel, apologies for the delay. Our AP team moved to a new ERP and some invoices got stuck in approval. It should clear soon. Best, Ingrid

mail.subject: Board deck: draft by Tuesday?
mail.body: Hi Daniel, could you send me a draft of the board deck by Tuesday EOD? Mostly want to see the pipeline slide and the runway number before we meet. Our prep call is Tuesday at 2. Thanks! Rachel

mail.subject: C&P demo clash tomorrow
mail.body:
Heads up, you have the Cedar & Pine demo sitting on top of the board prep with Rachel tomorrow afternoon. I can run the first 15 min of the demo solo if that helps, Olu mostly wants the NetSuite part anyway.

M
